normal_rule: common frozen standard-normal array for all authors within target/source replicate; SeedSequence([seed,16,target_number,bootstrap]); numerical integration randomness is not author information

T2.target: E[s_T | observed prefix, frozen source model ensemble]
T2.approximation: MAP plus central-Hessian Gaussian Laplace personal parameters; Gaussian moment interval; empirical source bootstrap mixture
T2.reference: mean and ddof=1 standard deviation of the same scoring function on 300 source prefixes
T2.unsupported: retain MAP or curvature failures; never drop and renormalize source weights

T3.independent_builder: separate agent receives only brief, mathematical handbook, source data and bundle schema; no T1/T2 implementation
T3.reference: same target scorer on source prefixes; no application normalization

limits: no external API or neural training
no private text or questionnaire access
do not inherit earlier F13 interval calibration automatically
